read.thesis: Alumina market tightening outside China (API ~$370/t) and aluminium inventories at 42 days support pricing, but Western Australia mine approvals slip into 2027 and AliGroup adds $3.1B cash consideration with leverage targeted at 1.5x.

utilisation.quote: Alumina Production -- 2.5 million metric tons, an 11% sequential increase resulting from improved stability at the Pinjarra refinery in Australia.

capex.peers_comment: Management said Indonesia will add 1.5 million metric tons of smelting capacity in 2027 and the market should absorb it.
capex.quote: we are thinking that we are going to see probably 1.5 million metric tons of smelting capacity come online in Indonesia next year

triggers.label: Indonesia adds 1.5Mt smelting in 2027
triggers.quote: we are thinking that we are going to see probably 1.5 million metric tons of smelting capacity come online in Indonesia next year

triggers.label: Alumina API ~$370/t, tightening ex-China

triggers.quote: Global aluminum inventories remain historically low at approximately 42 days of consumption
